company.name: Volex Plc
company.description: Volex plc manufactures and sells power and connectivity in North America, Europe, and Asia. It provides integrated manufacturing services, such as high level assembly, box build, electromechanical assemblies and systems, wiring harness and cable assembly, printed circuit board assembly, video display systems, and embedded systems; electric vehicle charging solutions; copper interconnect cables and data transfer cables; and data center power cables and power cords. The company also offers power cords, plugs, connectors, receptacles, as well as custom wiring harness and cable assemblies, including battery cables, busbars, commercial wiring harnesses, consumer wiring harnesses, fuse boxes, wiring harnesses, and wires and cables. Its products are used in complex industrial technology, consumer electricals, electric vehicle, medical, and off-highway. The company sells its products to original equipment manufacturers, contract equipment manufacturers, and distributors. Volex plc was founded in 1892 and is headquartered in Basingstoke, the United Kingdom.
